messages:
marina (partnerships): Quick sync - Acme SI asked how to report usage on day 0 (customer provisioned mid-billing-cycle). They plan to send daily aggregates. What exact fields do we need so billing/prorate works?
aj (eng): Minimal required: idempotency_key, customer_id, plan_id, start_ts, end_ts, aggregated_units. For prorate we also need provisioned_at and currency.
devon (acme-sysint): Acme can emit daily JSON. We currently don't include a free-tier flag. Can you explain how Redwood expects free-tier consumption represented?
lucy (billing): Add includes_free_tier (boolean) and free_tier_consumed_amount (integer). Example: if the plan gives 10k free tokens/day and customer used 3k on day 0, free_tier_consumed_amount=3000. Billing uses aggregated_units - free_tier_consumed_amount, then prorates by time in window.
aj (eng): Technical notes: timestamps must be ISO8601 with Z or explicit offset. If you send local timestamps without offset DST will create reconciliation noise. Prefer UTC.
devon (acme-sysint): ok we'll send UTC. For idempotency, what's the key format?
aj (eng): Any stable string unique per partner+customer+window works. We dedupe on idempotency_key. Also include a signature header X-Partner-Signature: HMAC-SHA256(hex) over the body using your shared secret. We'll return 200 on accept, 202 if queued, 4xx on schema error.
marina (partnerships): Who drafts the partner-facing onboarding text and example payload? Also need an internal runbook for disputes (late backfills).
lucy (billing): I'll draft the customer-facing blurb and a numeric example showing midday provisioning, free-tier subtraction, and prorated charge. Add that disputes triggered within 30 days follow normal billing dispute flow.
aj (eng): Action items: 1) I'll add a sample payload + HMAC example to the partner onboarding docs. 2) @devon confirm test payload schedule. 3) @lucy add billing example and dispute window.
devon (acme-sysint): We will update exporter, send our first test payload 2025-08-01, daily at 02:00 UTC. We'll include start_ts/end_ts covering the UTC day, provisioned_at, includes_free_tier and free_tier_consumed_amount.
ingest-bot: Reminder: partner-usage-schema-validator scheduled nightly 03:30 UTC - will flag missing free_tier fields.
marina (partnerships): Great, I'll follow up with Acme PM and confirm the test. Thanks all :thumbsup:
